info.title: Serendiva API
info.description: REST API for the Serendiva private-guide website. Public endpoints are read-only (plus form submissions). Admin endpoints under /api/v1/admin require the httpOnly session cookie set by POST /api/v1/admin/auth/login. Errors always use the shape { "error": { "code", "message", "details?" } }.

post.summary: Request a corporate proposal (multipart form with optional PDF/DOCX brief)
post.description:
Send as **multipart/form-data** (not JSON). Fields:

| field | rules |
| --- | --- |
| company | required, 2–160 chars |
| contactPerson | required, 2–120 chars |
| email | required, valid email |
| phone | required, 5–40 chars |
| groupSize | required, ≤ 60 chars (e.g. "25–40 guests") |
| dates | required, ≤ 120 chars |
| eventType | required, ≤ 80 chars |
| logistics | optional, ≤ 10 items of ≤ 60 chars — repeat the field per item or send one comma-separated value |
| message | optional, ≤ 5000 chars |
| sourcePage | optional, ≤ 300 chars |
| locale | optional, en / zh / de (default en) |
| website | honeypot — leave empty |
| turnstileToken | Cloudflare Turnstile token (required only when Turnstile is enabled) |
| attachment | optional file, PDF or DOCX, ≤ 5 MB (checked by content, not by extension) |

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with `details: [{ path, message }]`, 413 when the attachment is larger than 5 MB,
415 when it is not a PDF/DOCX (both with `details: [{ path: "attachment", message }]`).

post.summary: Upload 1–20 images or documents (multipart/form-data)
post.description:
Send `multipart/form-data` with:

- `files` — 1–20 files (repeat the field). Images: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF; documents: PDF, DOCX. Max 10 MB each. The type is detected from the file content, not the name or browser MIME type.
- `altText` (optional) — English alt text applied to every uploaded file (max 300 characters).
- `folder` (optional) — lowercase slug used in the storage path, e.g. `tours`, `blog`, `gallery` (default `general`).

Images are re-encoded to WebP (EXIF removed) with `thumb` (400px), `medium` (1024px) and `large` (1920px) variants and a blur placeholder; animated GIFs keep their first frame. Documents are stored as-is.

Every file is handled independently: rejected files are listed in `errors` and the others are still saved (the response is 201 even when every file was rejected — check `errors`). More than 20 files → 413.
